prompt:
CONCEPT: a citizen of the Iron Nation, of the Rust House. A female personification character with an old rusted iron key — a ring bow, a long shank and a notched bit as her motif — the object reimagined as a woman in cloth and ornament that carry its materials, colors, shape and motifs. She does NOT hold, carry or wield the object; it is not a separate object. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Iron (Fe) to carry in her design and the scene: dark grey iron with bright steel highlights, orange-brown rust and glowing forge-orange heat, magnetism (iron filings, lodestone), hardness and weight, the smell of a smithy; it is the element of tools, weapons, bridges, machines and blood. Palette: iron grey, steel silver, rust orange, ember red, black soot.
HOUSE TRAITS of Rust: flaking orange-brown rust over pitted dark iron, layered patina creeping over metal, worn leather straps, the look of something buried and dug up. Palette: rust orange, ochre, dark pitted iron, faded leather brown.
AGE: in her twenties — smooth youthful skin, soft full cheeks; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases) and a soft smile that never creases her face.
SILHOUETTE: broad-shouldered and strong build; long wavy hair; tarnished old-brass brown hair.
FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): round face; narrow upturned eyes; sharp angled brows; straight narrow nose; thin long lips; rust-amber eyes.
WORLD — STEAMPUNK: the Industrial Revolution around 1860: a cast-iron railway bridge over a river, a steam locomotive with a glowing firebox, blast furnaces and chimneys, riveted iron girders, gauges and valves, coal smoke under a copper sunset. COSTUME (citizen, steampunk): her object leads — its silhouette, parts and materials must read at first glance in her outfit and headpiece, the object reimagined as cloth, leather and brass fittings; the steampunk era only sets the late-Victorian cut and the brass-and-leather finish. Steam, pipes and gauges in the scene; no modern plastic, no sci-fi. LIGHT: hazy gaslight and a smoky overcast sky, unless TIME & WEATHER says otherwise.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
EXPOSURE (bold): her outfit opens to show skin — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or a short hem where the outfit allows; pieces stay symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; no corset; keep the object's shape, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
source: 생성기 조립 그대로 — 철나라 주민 첫 묶음(2026-10-31, 기본 화풍 2.5D). 머리색은 물건 재질, 머리·얼굴형·눈은 가문주와 다르게, 옷은 물건이 먼저. 메모가 없는 세계는 장면 변주로 배경을 갈랐다
